_comment: FRAGCITY WEBSITE RUNTIME TEMPLATE. Copy this file once to settings/settings.json and edit that private copy. This tracked example contains placeholders only. The application ignores every _comment field; these fields are readable inline notes while keeping the file valid JSON.

app._comment: General website runtime behavior. Keep a different settings/settings.json for Laragon and Production.

databases._comment: Website database profiles only. Do not add GLOBAL_weaponpaints here: WeaponPaints is reached only through the signed Linux API. The extends setting inherits another profile, while name can select a separate schema.

main._comment: Main FragCity website DB. Use local Laragon credentials here; configure the shared-hosting Production credentials only in that host's private runtime file. Prefer a least-privilege DB user rather than root.
main.name: kyonxcbt_fragcity_services

plugin_sync._comment: Optional separate schema for plugin synchronization. Leave name empty until the schema and permissions are intentionally provisioned.

legacy_services._comment: Compatibility profile for older site pages. This currently inherits main; change it only if a separate legacy schema is deliberately maintained.

ranks_plugin._comment: Optional Ranks plugin database. Leave name empty to avoid accidentally pointing the plugin at the website DB.

simpleadmin_plugin._comment: Optional SimpleAdmin plugin database. Leave name empty until its schema and restricted credentials are configured.

integrations._comment: Server-side integrations. Never expose any API secret or Steam/ZarinPal credential to browser JavaScript or commit real values.

steam._comment: Steam OpenID / Steam Web API integration used by login and profile features.

zarinpal._comment: Payment gateway settings. Keep merchant_id empty in local development and never test real payment flows unintentionally.

weaponpaints_api._comment: Signed Linux API for WeaponPaints. Its secret matches the root shared_secret in /etc/fragcity-api/config.php. This is separate from both Pterodactyl secrets.

pterodactyl_standby_api._comment: Signed Linux API for the public CS2 Server Browser (Pterodactyl inventory + A2S_INFO). Its secret matches pterodactyl_standby.shared_secret in the Linux runtime config.

pterodactyl_monitoring_api._comment: Signed Linux API for the admin-only Pterodactyl/Wings monitoring page. Its secret matches pterodactyl_monitoring.shared_secret on Linux and must be unique.

files._comment: Per-page and per-class settings. database_profile values refer to keys under databases above; do not put passwords or API tokens in this section.

class.config._comment: WeaponPaints catalogue language, appearance and local asset paths.

images._comment: Paths are relative to the website document root. Keep the local img/weapon assets in the repository.

class.customer_db._comment: CustomerDB uses the selected website DB profile.

steam.steam_login._comment: Steam login route destinations and database ownership.

pages.zarinpal.wallet_request._comment: Website DB profile used to create a wallet payment request.

pages.zarinpal.wallet_callback._comment: Website DB profile used to verify and apply a wallet payment callback.

pages.zarinpal.buyserver_request._comment: Website DB profile for the legacy buy-server payment request page. This does not enable server provisioning by itself.

pages.zarinpal.buyserver_callback._comment: Website DB profile for the legacy buy-server payment callback. Keep server purchase disabled until the new Pterodactyl billing lifecycle is implemented.

pages.buyserveropen._comment: Website DB profile used by the public buy-server information page. This page is not a Pterodactyl provisioning API.

pages.serverlist._comment: Retained page DB profile setting for compatibility. The active Server Browser now obtains server data from pterodactyl_standby_api, not a database port-range scanner.

pages.vip._comment: Website DB profile for VIP status and purchase records.

pages.forgot_password._comment: Compatibility database profile for password-reset requests. Keep aligned with the users table actually used by the site.

pages.reset_password._comment: Compatibility database profile for password-reset completion.

tst.index._comment: Database profile used by the optional TST page.

database.ranks_plugin._comment: Database profile for the Ranks plugin adapter.

database.simpleadmin_plugin._comment: Database profile for the SimpleAdmin plugin adapter.

database.weaponpaints_plugin._comment: WeaponPaints is API-only. Keep transport set to api; do not add a direct DB profile for GLOBAL_weaponpaints.

panels.cs2.overview._comment: Website DB profile for CS2 panel overview data.

panels.cs2.players._comment: Website DB profile for CS2 player data.

panels.cs2.servers._comment: Website DB profile for the CS2 panel's server catalogue. Live node monitoring is a separate signed Linux API integration.

pages.support._comment: Website DB profile for support tickets and replies.
